# Your report

The four-category subset of the 20 Newsgroups dataset was loaded (Result ID: `load_dataset_1`), containing 2,257 documents. A random sample of 500 documents was selected using `random_state=42` (Result ID: `sample_data_2`). The sampled texts were tokenised into lowercase unigrams (`tokenize_3`), and a document-term matrix (DTM) was constructed using CountVectorizer (`build_dtm_4`). The resulting DTM contained 500 documents and 16,283 features, with 81,463 non-zero entries and a sparsity of 98.9994%.

Term-frequency analysis (`term_frequency_5`) identified the most frequent words, including “the” (6,622) and “of” (3,979). Variance filtering (`variance_filter_6`) was performed with a threshold of 0.1, retaining 996 features and removing 15,287 features. Pearson and Spearman correlation analyses (`pearson_filter_7`–`pearson_filter_10` and `spearman_filter_11`–`spearman_filter_14`) ranked terms according to their relationships with each of the four categories. For example, “keith” had the strongest Pearson correlation with *alt.atheism* (0.438), while “atheists” had the strongest Spearman correlation (0.478). These analyses ranked features but did not remove any terms.

Cosine similarity between the first two sampled documents was calculated as 0.26 (`cosine_15`). A feature-correlation matrix containing the 20 selected features was generated (`feature_corr_20`), with “jpeg” and “gif” showing the strongest correlation (0.971). The labels were also converted into a binary matrix of 500 documents and four categories (`binarized_labels_19`). Dimensionality reduction was performed using PCA, t-SNE and UMAP (`reduction_16`, `reduction_17` and `reduction_18`). The first two PCA components explained approximately 70.04% and 7.92% of the variance, respectively. The three methods generated two-dimensional visualisations for examining the structure and distribution of the document categories.

The pattern-mining step was attempted but could not be completed because `mine_patterns_tool` encountered a `TypeError` involving an unsupported `threshold` argument. Therefore, no frequent-pattern results are included. Classification was not performed, so no model evaluation metrics are reported. The generated visualisations are saved in the `plots/` directory: `Jerrye_Eng_Zhe_agentic-pipeline_plot_reduction_16.png` (PCA), `Jerrye_Eng_Zhe_agentic-pipeline_plot_reduction_17.png` (t-SNE), `Jerrye_Eng_Zhe_agentic-pipeline_plot_reduction_18.png` (UMAP), and `Jerrye_Eng_Zhe_agentic-pipeline_plot_feature_corr_20.png` (feature-correlation heatmap).
